interface.title: NDT Lens · 射线检测与自学习标注 (X-RAY INSPECTION v0.3)
interface.field: Industrial non-destructive testing: weld radiography defect inspection
interface.stage_of_work: Data annotation, model training, and screening or auto-labeling new images with human review
interface.what_it_is_for: Inspectors use it to draw and confirm porosity, crack and inclusion boxes on weld X-ray images, train a YOLO11 detector on the confirmed boxes, and use that model or a morphology heuristic to suggest defect candidates that a person must review.

data.note: Two built-in sources were used. One is the synthetic 512×512 example image in 检测工作台. The other is the 15-image synthetic demo project, created by 打开合成演示项目 under /work/app/data/demo-workbench (train 11, val 2, test 2; 12 confirmed images and 27 confirmed boxes at the start). No test files were available to upload, so the import path was not tried.

tree.general: Build a labelled image set of defects, train a detector on it, and use the detector or a heuristic to flag defects in new images, with a human checking every suggestion
tree.specific: Annotate weld X-ray images for porosity, crack and inclusion, train YOLO11 on confirmed labels, auto-label pending images and review them

features.name: Bounding-box annotation canvas with class picker, zoom, undo/clear and editable coordinate table
features.general: Pick a label class, drag rectangles on an image (zoomable), undo or clear them, then correct the class or coordinates in a linked table. Coordinates are kept in original-image pixels.
features.specific: In 图片与标注, choose 绘制类别 (porosity, crack or inclusion), set 画布缩放 between 1 and 3, drag boxes on the X-ray, use 撤销上一个框 or 清空所有框, and edit 缺陷类别/x1/y1/x2/y2 in the table below
steps: drag a rectangle over the defect
undo or clear boxes if wrong
change the class or a coordinate in the table row
serves_tasks: Draw labelled boxes around each defect, fix mistakes, and confirm the image as training data
Label a second image at higher magnification and save it as a draft that is left out of training

features.name: Review-state image queue with confirm or draft save
features.general: Filter the image list by review status (all, pending, confirmed), open one, and save its labels either as confirmed training data or as a draft that is left out of training. Counters and split tables update after a confirm; a draft save shows no message and the image stays pending.
features.specific: Use 查看范围 (全部图片 / 待复核 / 已确认) and the 选择图片 list (✓ confirmed, ○ pending, with part group and split), then press 保存并确认标注 or 保存草稿（不参与训练）. After a confirm the 已确认标注 and 已确认缺陷框 counters and the 数据集就绪情况 table update; after a draft save the image still reads 待复核.
steps: pick an image from the list
press confirm or save as draft
check the updated counters and the image's status
serves_tasks: Pick an unlabelled image from the project list
Draw labelled boxes around each defect, fix mistakes, and confirm the image as training data
Label a second image at higher magnification and save it as a draft that is left out of training

features.name: Dataset split readiness panel

features.name: Background training job with status refresh, log and validation-metric chart
features.general: Set epochs, image size, batch size, device and initialization, launch a background training run, refresh to follow it through queued, running and finished, then read the log, the validation mAP curve and the path of the saved model
features.specific: In 训练中心, set 训练轮数, 训练图像边长, 批次大小, 计算设备 and 初始化方式 (通用预训练权重 / 从零训练 / 继续学习所选缺陷模型), then press 从已确认标注启动训练 and 刷新训练状态. The run expander shows 排队中 → 训练中 → 训练完成, the Ultralytics log, best.pt and the metrics/mAP50(B) and mAP50-95(B) chart.
steps: expand the finished run to see the curves and the weights path

Check that training finished and look at the validation curves and the saved model file

features.name: Model-assisted batch pre-labelling with confidence threshold
features.general: Pick a trained model and a confidence cutoff, then run it over every image awaiting review. Its suggestions become pending labels for a person to check, and each pre-labelled image records which model produced it.
features.specific: Choose the run in the sidebar 自动标注模型 (a 指定本地权重 option was not tried), set the 自动标注置信度 slider, and press 自动标注所有待复核图片 in 批量自动标注. The 模型标注待复核 counter rises, and an auto-labelled image shows 自动标注来源 with the weights path. Reviewing and confirming the suggested boxes was not achieved in this run.
steps: select a model in the sidebar
open a pre-labelled image and read its source line
serves_tasks: Select the new model and run it over every image still awaiting review
Open a model-labelled image and see which model produced its suggestions

features.name: Heuristic candidate detector with side-by-side view, sensitivity sliders and report export
features.general: Run a rule-based blob detector on one image, tune its contrast threshold and minimum region size, compare the original and annotated images side by side with a table of boxes, and export the result as PNG, JSON or CSV
features.specific: In 检测工作台 with 演示 · 候选区域, set 灰度差阈值 (5–60) and 最小候选面积 (3–200 px). The page shows 01 原始图像 and 02 定位结果, the 区域明细 table and the 候选区域 count, with 下载标注图像, 下载 JSON 报告 and 下载 CSV 明细. The other mode, 已训练模型 · YOLO, takes a weights path and a confidence value; in this run it was only seen with no weights found, so it produced no detections.
steps: choose an image (upload or built-in example)
adjust the threshold and minimum-area sliders
download the annotated image, JSON or CSV
